text: The list of applicants and the relevant details of the applications are set out in the appended table.
The applicants are members of the religious organization "Bozhya Slava" based in Syktyvkar.
The applicants complained of various restrictions imposed by the authorities on the location of public religious events.
The applicants complained of various restrictions imposed by the authorities on the time of public religious events.
Some applicants raised complaints about the lack of domestic remedies against the alleged violations of their freedom of assembly.
